description: Internal API definitions and callback structures for Bluetooth Media Control in Zephyr, including function prototypes, macros, and conditional compilation for OTS support.

classes.name: media_proxy_sctrl_cbs
classes.description: Structure containing callback function pointers for media control events.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_register
methods.description: Registers a controller with the media proxy using provided callbacks.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_player_name
methods.description: Returns the current media player's name.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_icon_id
methods.description: Returns the current icon ID (if OTS is enabled).

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_icon_url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the media icon.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_track_title
methods.description: Returns the current track title.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_track_duration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the current track.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_track_position
methods.description: Returns the current track position.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_set_track_position
methods.description: Sets the current track position.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_playback_speed
methods.description: Returns the playback speed.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_set_playback_speed
methods.description: Sets the playback speed.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_seeking_speed
methods.description: Returns the seeking speed.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_track_segments_id
methods.description: Returns the current track segments ID (if OTS is enabled).

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_current_track_id
methods.description: Returns the current track ID (if OTS is enabled).

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_set_current_track_id
methods.description: Sets the current track ID (if OTS is enabled).

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_next_track_id
methods.description: Returns the next track ID (if OTS is enabled).

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_set_next_track_id
methods.description: Sets the next track ID (if OTS is enabled).

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_current_group_id
methods.description: Returns the current group ID (if OTS is enabled).

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_set_current_group_id
methods.description: Sets the current group ID (if OTS is enabled).

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_parent_group_id
methods.description: Returns the parent group ID (if OTS is enabled).

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_playing_order
methods.description: Returns the current playing order.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_set_playing_order
methods.description: Sets the playing order.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_playing_orders_supported
methods.description: Returns supported playing orders.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_media_state
methods.description: Returns the current media state.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_send_command
methods.description: Sends a media control command.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_commands_supported
methods.description: Returns supported commands.

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_send_search
methods.description: Sends a search request (if OTS is enabled).

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_search_results_id
methods.description: Returns search results ID (if OTS is enabled).

methods.name: media_proxy_sctrl_get_content_ctrl_id
methods.description: Returns content control ID.
